text: こんな　とこ　うろちょろ　してたのか！

structure.jp: うろちょろ　してたのか！

patterns.name: 〜のか
patterns.explanation: のか at the end, said as an exclamation, shows the speaker has just found something out. してたのか = 'so that's what you were doing!'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた shows something was going on for a while; てた is the short spoken form. うろちょろ してた = 'were wandering about'.
